description: Reads the home page of a company the user wants to nominate and returns its name as the site writes it, the award it reads like, and, from 16 December when nominees are announced, whether it is already a nominee or in review (before then it never says). Stores nothing. Call it before awards_nominate and show the user the name and award.

website.description: The company's own website, for example northwind.com. Not a LinkedIn or social profile.

name: awards_lookup_company
title: Check a company before nominating
